# Terakota Foundation

> Terakota Foundation is a free, open-source CLI scaffold for building full-featured React dashboard applications. It is the community layer of Terakota, a product by Intacata.

Terakota Foundation generates complete, production-ready dashboard applications from an interactive CLI. Users select a framework, styling approach, layout variant, and optional features. The CLI assembles a working codebase with routing, Redux state management, MUI theming, authentication pages, internationalisation, and an 8-variant runtime-switchable layout system.

## Key facts

- **Repository**: https://github.com/intacata-org/terakota-lite/tree/foundation
- **Branch**: `foundation` (within the `terakota-lite` monorepo)
- **Organisation**: Intacata (https://intacata.com)
- **Product**: Terakota (https://terakota.live)
- **License**: MIT
- **Current stable version**: 1.3.1
- **Node.js requirement**: >= 18.0.0
- **Usage**: `node create.js MyApp` (no global install required)

## Supported frameworks

- Vite (SPA, PWA, Electron) — stable
- TanStack Router (type-safe SPA) — beta
- Next.js App Router (SSR, RSC) — beta
- Next.js Pages Router (classic Next.js) — beta
- Create React App / CRA (webpack, legacy) — beta
- Astro (basic starter) — starter only

## What is generated

A full dashboard application with:
- 8-variant layout system (sidebar, horizontal, tabbed, minimal — all runtime-switchable)
- Redux Toolkit state management
- MUI component library (v7 for Vite/Next/CRA, v6 for TanStack)
- Optional Tailwind CSS or Shadcn/ui
- Dark / Light / System theme with localStorage persistence
- RTL layout direction support
- Authentication pages (Login, Register, Lock Screen)
- i18n with English and Arabic translations
- Widget / dashboard canvas system
- Toast notification system
- PWA / Electron support (framework-dependent)
- TypeScript by default (JavaScript also available)

## Technology stack

React 18/19, Redux Toolkit, MUI (Material UI), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, i18next, react-i18next, Vite 4, Next.js 15, TanStack Router 1.50, Emotion, Styled Components, Iconify

## Compatibility

Actively tested on macOS 10.15 Catalina and newer. Works on Windows 10/11 and Ubuntu 20.04+.
